_notes:
VL53L4CD time-of-flight distance sensor, up to about 1.3 m, at 0x29 (fixed at power-up). 16-bit register index
Detection: IDENTIFICATION__MODEL_ID (0x010F) = 0xEB and MODULE_TYPE (0x0110) = 0xAA. The VL53L4CX reads the same (ST's VL53L4CX driver identifies it by these two values too, IsL4()), so a VL53L4CX is identified as this record and runs as described here: on-chip ranging, as the VL53L4CD does, not the VL53L4CX's histogram ranging (up to about 6 m, done by ST's driver on the host - not possible in a record, see RaftCore devdocs/vl53l4cx-histogram-ranging-plan.md, parked). On Axiom018 (2026-10-26) a VL53L4CX (revision 0x10) ranged with this record
Init: ST's VL53L4CD Ultra Lite Driver (ULD) VL53L4CD_SensorInit: its default configuration (0x2D-0x87, written in three blocks then 0x87), except bit 0 of 0x2E and 0x2F set (I2C and GPIO pull-ups at AVDD, as on breakout boards, where the ULD's default is pull-ups at 1.8 V); a warm-up range for VHV (0x87 = 0x40, a 200 ms pause in place of the ULD's wait for data ready), clear the interrupt, stop ranging (0x87 = 0x00), two VHV bounds (0x0008 = 0x09), VHV from the previous temperature (0x000B = 0x00), 0x0024 = 0x0500; then VL53L4CD_SetRangeTiming(50 ms, continuous): no inter-measurement period (0x006C = 0) and the range timeouts (0x005E, 0x0061) calculated by initCode from the sensor's oscillator frequency (0x0006) as the ULD does (skipped if it reads 0); then clear the interrupt and start continuous ranging (0x87 = 0x21)
Poll: GPIO__TIO_HV_STATUS (0x0031), then 15 bytes from RESULT__RANGE_STATUS (0x0089-0x0097), then clear the interrupt (0x0086 = 0x01). fresh is 1 when a new range is ready (0x0031 bit 0 is 0: the configuration's interrupt is active low, 0x0030 bit 4). rangeStatus is the raw status (0x0089 bits 4:0): 9 is a valid range (the ULD's status 0), 6 sigma, 4 signal, 5 phase, 7 wrap-around. sigma is the range's standard deviation estimate in mm (0x0092, /4); dist is the range in mm (0x0096)
Sample rate (_conf.rate) sets only the poll interval: the sensor ranges back to back with a 50 ms timing budget whatever the rate. A different timing budget isn't an action, as its timeouts are calculated from each sensor's oscillator frequency
Source: the default configuration, the init and timing sequence and the status codes are from ST's VL53L4CD Ultra Lite Driver (as packaged by ST in https://github.com/stm32duino/VL53L4CD, src/vl53l4cd_api.cpp), BSD-3-Clause; see RaftCore's THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for its notice

rsao.note: bench (Axiom018, 2026-10-26, a VL53L4CX - it reads the VL53L4CD's identification): the lone 0x99 is half of the 16-bit register index; the 9-byte read returns zeros. Nothing is written, as no data byte follows. The configuration (0x2D-0x85), oscillator (0x0006), VHV (0x0008-0x000B), offsets (0x0016-0x0023) and oscillator calibration (0x00DE) unchanged; ranging carried on (0x0087 = 0x21). Its address is in Axiom's excluded RSAO range anyway
